title: Train an MLP on XOR
learning_objectives: Implement full backpropagation for a 2-layer network
Train with gradient descent until XOR is solved
Explain why a linear model cannot solve XOR
entry_point: init_params(n_hidden, seed); forward_backward(X, y, params); train_xor(n_hidden=8, lr=1.0, epochs=3000, seed=0)
hints: Forward: `h = np.tanh(X @ W1 + b1)`, `p = sigmoid(h @ W2 + b2)[:, 0]`.

failure_feedback.advice: Check δ1 = (δ2 W2ᵀ) ⊙ (1 − h²) and that δ2 is divided by n.
Draw W1 then W2 from one default_rng(seed); biases are zeros.
Compute all gradients first, then update every parameter with lr.
With zero weights p = 0.5 everywhere, so the loss is log 2.
